segments.he: רבינו ז"ל אמר שאם היו"כ אינו כראוי (היינו שלא יכול להתפלל ביו"כ כראוי) אז השם ה' יהי' כראוי "אז דער יו"כ איז ניט גווען ווייא עס בדארץ ציא זיין זאל חאטשי דער גאסט נאבין זיין וויא עס בדארץ ציא זיין" (היינו מחרת יו"כ שנקרא בפי העולם שם ה' כידוע): היינו שיהי' התחזקות אפי' ביו"כ שאז הזמן מוכשר מאד לתשובה ולא עבר כראוי יחזק א"ע ומתי שיעשה טוב הוא טוב וכן אומרים אנ"ש (בשם מהרנ"ת) אפי' כשכל השמ"ע לא התפלל כראוי עכ"פ יתפלל אלקי נצור כראוי וכו':
segments.en: But despite this, they succeeded with the government to station soldiers at his home who went through his house even on Shabbos — and this continued until Erev Pesach at midday, when they were taken back through the efforts of our fellowship. And on the night of Pesach when he went out in the morning, they found that the entire outside of Moharan'as's house had been painted with crosses — top and bottom — which the opponents had painted on all his walls. And yet the wicked were like a turbulent sea that could not be quieted — for they were furious that Moharan'as had the audacity to return to his home and was not killed. Therefore they reached the decision among themselves: Reuven of Yartzis — the greatest among them, a great scholar and so forth — had a son-in-law in Beroshid named Pinchasil who was also a scholar and man of good family and greatly esteemed among them, and he had already taken it upon himself personally to kill Moharan'as. They decided that immediately on the first day of chol ha'mo'ed they would send Reuven of Yartzis a special wagon — through one of their ruffians — to bring his son-in-law Pinchasil from Beroshid to his father-in-law Reuven for the last days of Pesach. And through this, certainly the end of Moharan'as would come, G-d forbid.
